system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

The Sarutobi clan has a unique talent for manifesting multiple different nature releases, focusing in on a core martial fighting technique or broadening their illusory skills. You have reached that decision point. Select one:

You gain another Nature release you didn’t select from your Advanced Nature Affinity clan trait.

Select a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu Expert stance, even if you don’t qualify. You gain the benefits of the chosen Expert stance while in your Cross-Style stance.

While in your Cross-Style stance, creatures that critically succeed a saving throw against a Genjutsu you cast, suffer the effects of a success if you spend 2 Will.
